newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss private bank Ferrier Lullin profit up 18 pct.
newsitem.headline: Swiss private bank Ferrier Lullin profit up 18 pct.

text.p: Swiss private bank Ferrier Lullin & Cie said its 1996 net profits rose 18.4 percent to 17.2 million Swiss francs.
The Geneva bank said in a statement that its balance sheet assets totalled 470 million Swiss francs as of end-1996.
The bank gave no details on its accounts, the volume of private assets under management or their performance.
Swiss private banks do not publish data on the volume of assets they manage, a by-product of their culture of bank secrecy. Bank annual reports that are published provide only scanty information.
Western bankers say Swiss provate bankers had no reason to be transparent until the arrival of Western giants, but that fierce competition is forcing them to open up a bit.
Total private wealth under management in Switzerland is more than $1.8 trillion, according to a recent survey by Credit Suisse First Boston Bank.
